vue.description: Vue 3 Bento Grid outer adapter wrapping @exhuma/core headless primitive.
vue.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BentoGrid as BentoGridPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
import { clsx } from 'clsx';

interface Props {
  class?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  class: '',
});
</script>

<template>
  <BentoGridPrimitive
    v-bind="props"
    :class="clsx('grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-rows-[22rem] max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </BentoGridPrimitive>
</template>

svelte.description: Svelte 5 Bento Grid adapter using runes and @exhuma/core primitives.
svelte.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { BentoGrid as BentoGridPrimitive } from '@exhuma/core';
  import { clsx } from 'clsx';

  let {
    class: className = '',
    children,
    ...restProps
  }: {
    class?: string;
    children?: import('svelte').Snippet;
    [key: string]: unknown;
  } = $props();
</script>

<BentoGridPrimitive
  class={clsx('grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-rows-[22rem] max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full', className)}
  {...restProps}
>
  {@render children?.()}
</BentoGridPrimitive>
